title: Rank-Aware Differentially Private Release of Listwise Preferences for LLM Alignment
abstract: arXiv:2610.37682v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Listwise preference feedback offers richer supervision for large language model (LLMs) alignment than pairwise comparisons, but a full ranking also reveals more sensitive user preferences. Existing privacy-preserving alignment methods focus mainly on pairwise feedback, while listwise alignment under local differential privacy (LDP) remains unexplored. Extending LDP to this listwise domain raises a critical challenge: the high sensitivity of the full ranking space demands excessive noise, neutralizing the benefits of listwise supervision. To address this challenge, we analyze the interaction between supervision granularity and privacy noise in downstream training, and introduce a rank-aware exponential mechanism that privatizes listwise preference data into a low-sensitivity granularity suitable for downstream alignment. translated_title: 面向大语言模型对齐的排序感知差分隐私列表式偏好发布
translated_abstract: 列表式偏好反馈为大语言模型（LLM）对齐提供了比成对比较更丰富的监督信息，但完整的排序也会暴露更多敏感的用户偏好。现有的隐私保护对齐方法主要针对成对反馈，而在本地差分隐私（LDP）下的列表式对齐仍未被探索。将LDP扩展到列表式领域面临一个关键挑战：完整排序空间的高敏感性需要引入过量噪声，从而抵消列表式监督的优势。为解决这一挑战，我们分析了监督粒度与隐私噪声在下游训练中的相互作用，并提出了一种排序感知的指数机制，将列表式偏好数据私有化为适合下游对齐的低敏感性粒度。该机制利用排序信息来采样固定大小的二分划分，将噪声集中在边界附近（原文摘要至此处截断）。
tldr: 本文提出一种排序感知的指数机制，将列表式偏好数据私有化为低敏感性的固定大小二分划分粒度，解决了完整排序在本地差分隐私下噪声过大的难题，实现了隐私保护的大语言模型列表式偏好对齐。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a rank-aware exponential mechanism that privatizes listwise preference data into a low-sensitivity fixed-size binary partition granularity, addressing the excessive noise problem of full rankings under local differential privacy and enabling privacy-preserving listwise preference alignment for LLMs.
